rows.en: I'm counting on you, then, Luca.
Yes, Alto-senpai.

(Luca and Alto seemed to be getting along well...
How long have those two known each other?)
Luca, got a sec?
What is it, \p-san?

You and Alto get along really well.
How long have you known each other?

I met Alto-senpai right before
I graduated from middle school.

Alto-senpai suddenly came storming in,
yelling, while wearing a beautiful dress.
Honestly, it gave me quite a shock.
rows.notes: Alludes to Alto in his stage costume in Macross Frontier episode 1.

rows.en:
And that's also when I met Nanase-san...
For me, it was truly a fateful encounter......
rows.notes: Read 'boku ni tottemo' as 'boku ni totte, tottemo' (for me, truly); could also be 'for me as well'.

rows.en: W-Well, good for you.
(Huh~ So that's how they met.)

(It's so like Luca to start with Alto and end up
talking about how he met Nanase...)

(Luca-kun and Saotome-kun seemed to get along
well... How long have those two known each other?)
Luca-kun, got a sec?

You and Saotome-kun get along really well.
How long have you known each other?
W-Well, good for you.
(Huh~ So that's how they met.)

(It's so like Luca-kun to start with Saotome-kun
and end up talking about how he met Nanase...)

Um, \p-san,
aren't you hungry?

I guess I'm kind of hungry, but I was
thinking of eating at home today......

You're hungry, right?!
You can't possibly hold out till you get home!!
No, not really......

Then let's go to Nyan-Nyan!
I just really want some Galaxy Ramen!

Oh, \p-kun, Luca-kun,
welcome!

N-Nanase-san! You're the one who's
working so hard, thank you!
rows.notes: Luca flustered: answers her 'welcome' with 'Nanase-san koso otsukaresama desu' (no, YOU are the one working hard).

rows.en: (I see, so that's what this is about.)

Sorry I can't keep you company, we're busy
right now. Please take your time and relax.
Good luck with your work too, Nanase-san.
Luca-kun, we came here to eat, right?
rows.notes: The male player says 'Luca-kun' here (he says bare 'Luca' elsewhere); kept as in the Japanese, read as pointed teasing.

rows.en:
O-Of course we did!
What other reason could there possibly be?!
(Luca's really got it bad...)

Oh, \p-san, Luca-kun,
welcome!
(I see, so that's what this is about.)
Luca-kun, we came here to eat, right?
(Geez, Luca-kun's really got it bad...)

(Huh, there's a crowd gathering...
What's going on over there?)
rows.notes: x4: also opens nml_rnk_025 (male and female).

rows.en: Hey, Luca, that's Ranka over there, isn't it?
Looks like it. Maybe they're filming something?
Heyyy! Rankaaa! Go for it!!
rows.notes: Also used in nml_rnk_025 (player alone at a commercial shoot).

rows.en:
W-Wait a minute!
\p-san!!
Oh, looks like she noticed!
rows.notes: x3: in nml_rnk_025 the player is alone, so 'noticed us' is avoided.

rows.en: Well, of course she'd notice...
Hi, you two!

We hardly ever see you at school, so I was
worried, but I'm relieved you're doing well.
Being full of energy is my only strong point!
Well then, say hi to Nana-chan for me!

...Looks like you've found a good
conversation starter.
rows.notes: Teasing: something to talk to Nanase about.

rows.en:
Wh-What are you talking about... Geez...
Let's get back to shopping!!
(Luca's not one to admit his feelings either, huh.)
Hey, Luca-kun, that's Ranka-chan over there, right?
Heyyy! Ranka-chaaan!

...Looks like you've found a good
conversation starter.

(Luca-kun's not one to admit his feelings
either, huh.)

(The department store's having a sale today...
Hope they've got something good.)

Huh, isn't that...
Luca and Nanase over there...?
Hey, you two.
\p-san!
rows.notes: x4: Luca here; Shirakawa and Nanase in other scenes.

rows.en:
Are you two on a date?
My, my, things are heating up~

No! Absolutely not!!
We just ran into each other by pure, pure chance,
so we were talking a little! Just a tiny bit!

That's right, isn't it? That's how it was,
right, Luca-kun?!

...Huh?
Oh, yes, that's right, yeah...
Well then, I'll be going!!

Sorry, Luca...
Dinner's on me today...
Hahahaha... I'll be going too, then...
(I never thought she'd deny it THAT hard...)

(The department store's having a bargain sale
today. Hope they've got something good.)

Huh, isn't that...
Luca-kun and Nanase over there...?
Yoo-hoo~ you two!

Are you two on a date?
Kyaa~ How hot and heavy!

Sorry, Luca-kun...
...To make it up to you, how about
I go on a date with you?!
(...Huh? Did he just gently turn me down too?)

uncertain: c17958: the male player calls him 'Luca-kun' only in this line; kept as the Japanese.
c17938: 'boku ni tottemo' read as 'truly fateful for me'.
c17954: Luca's flustered 'Nanase-san koso otsukaresama desu' rendered as an over-eager thank-you.
